title: OPC UA base types of the OEC messages
description: OPC UA 1.05.04 JSON encoding (OPC 10000-6 5.4) of the built-in and structured types used by MG 8. Base types are open building blocks; a type with a requirement of its own (ConfigurationVersion, LocalizedText, NodeId) carries it in its $comment, all others inherit the requirement ($comment) of the referencing schema.

DateTime.$comment: RFC 3339 date-time with time zone (OPC UA DateTime, MG 8.1). The pattern bounds every field; calendar validity (e.g. 2026-02-30) is checked by the rule layer (R-4). format is an annotation only.

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-MSG-001 (MG 8): a sender adds no key beyond the guideline (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure

VerboseEnum.$comment: REQ-MSG-031 (MG 8.2.3): an enumeration is encoded as the string "<EnumName>_<EnumValue>" (VerboseEncoding), not as its numeric value; used in the allOf of every enumeration whose values end with _<number>

NodeId.$comment: REQ-MSG-039 (MG 8.2.6, GL-ADR-013): NodeId string of Part 6 5.1.12: i=<UInt32>, s=, g= or b= for namespace 0, nsu=<uri>;… for all other namespaces; neither ns=<index>; nor the JSON object form. The referencing schema adds "type": "string", so a non-string maps to the REQ of the object.

QualifiedName.$comment: QualifiedName as JSON string (Part 6 5.1.12): a plain name or nsu=<uri>;<name>, not empty and not in the namespace index form <index>:<name>; inherits the REQ of the referencing object.

LocalizedText.$comment: REQ-MSG-040 (MG 8.2.7): LocalizedText with Locale (LocaleId) and Text; the Text may be empty

unevaluatedProperties.$comment: REQ-MSG-001 (MG 8): a sender adds no key beyond the guideline (strict); the tolerant flavor drops this closure
